items.item_text: Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record in accordance with UCLA Health or UC system policy; enrollment in the California Employer Pull Notice Program may be required
Minimum of 5 years of experience in Materials Management or Supply Chain, including prior supervisory experience
Advanced computer proficiency, including experience Workdays SCM system or related software applications
High attention to detail with experience in data entry, spreadsheet management, and report generation

The Materials Management Supervisor oversees all aspects of supply chain operations within Materials Management, ensuring the timely and efficient flow of supplies, linen, and equipment across UCLA Health facilities. This includes supervision of logistics staff, managing inventory, maintaining PAR levels, and supporting patient care units and procedural areas.
Supervise and train logistics staff to ensure productivity and task completion across assigned shifts
Oversee product issues, transitions, and resolution processes
Assign routes and allocate tasks to staff for department operations and maintenance
Ensure excellent customer service and meet department service standards
Manage supply inventory, including ordering, receiving, distributing, and maintaining appropriate backup stock
Replenish inventory using supply chain management systems, handheld devices, or third-party tools
Perform physical inventory counts, maintain accurate documentation, and input data
Assess and adjust PAR levels to meet changing supply demands
Stock, clean, and organize inventory holding rooms and related areas
Distribute linen, supplies, and equipment throughout the health system per established procedures
Collaborate with clinical teams in procedural, interventional, and radiology areas to understand supply needs and preferences
Set up or modify inventory items within supply management software systems
Reconcile packing slips with orders and deliveries
Support inventory cost-saving initiatives and recommend process improvements
Salary offers are based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and internal equity.
Required Qualifications:
Physical Requirements:
Capable of performing manual tasks such as stocking, organizing, and moving supplies throughout the facility
Demonstrated ability to succeed in a fast-paced, high-volume environment as a proactive self-starter
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to provide and follow detailed instructions
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills with a proven commitment to exceptional customer service
Skilled in process analysis and improvement, with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
Proficient in basic math and inventory-related calculations (e.g., replenishment metrics, units of measure, package counts)
Ability to manage strict deadlines and follow protocols with consistency and accountability
Familiarity with University policies, infection control practices, and relevant regulatory requirements
Ability to lift, carry, and transport items weighing up to 50 pounds
Ability to push and pull linen carts weighing up to 400 pounds
